mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact the S&P 500 over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) over a 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 6% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises above 6% but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in employment (PAYEMS) coupled with a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases but S&P 500 returns are not positive over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) leads to inflationary pressures, potentially causing the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which could negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 growth slows and INDPRO declines but S&P 500 returns are not negative over the next 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which should positively impact the S&P 500 over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by more than 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS falls below 400,000 but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 5 days.
